products.body:
Experience the DUROCHAIN Difference

DUROCHAIN Premium #08BHP Hollow-Pin Connecting Links are made for specific use with #08BHP single-strand hollow-pin metric roller chain. Also commonly referred to as master links, these connecting links provide a secure and dimensionally accurate method for joining two sections of compatible hollow-pin chain.

Each DUROCHAIN #08BHP connecting link is manufactured from premium carbon steel with hardened high-strength pins, precision-prepared straight sideplates, and shot-peened components. This carefully controlled construction helps improve strength, fatigue resistance, component fitment, and dependable link performance in demanding conveying and material-handling applications.

The hollow-pin configuration maintains the versatility of the adjoining chain, allowing cross rods, attachments, fixtures, and other components to pass through the assembled link. Common applications include packaging machinery, sorting equipment, textile machinery, incline conveyors, production lines, and customized material-handling systems.

products.body:
Metric 08B stainless steel hollow pin roller chain is manufactured in accordance to ISO 606B, BS228 British, and DIN8187 German manufacturing standards. Our 08BHPSS hollow pin stainless stele roller chain utilizes precision components, a solid roller (seamless) design, and is manufactured from high-quality 304-grade stainless steel. 304SS is a highly anti-corrosive material with a very low magnetic pull, its also capable of operating in very low to very high temperatures without degrading the working and performance capacity of the chain. The hollow pin design makes the chain capable of having attachments fastened through its holes (hollow pins) for conveying and elevating applications.

  • Hollow Pin Inner Diameter (d6): 4mm
  • Pin Length (b4): 19mm
  • Connecting Link Added Width (b7): 1.5mm
  • Total Inner Link Width (b2): 13.8mm
